Senses.Note: One corpus-wide referent. The mirror's uses in exposure, distinction, and self-inspection are deployments of the same object, not separate things.

Occurrences.Kwic: 何故？當軒秦鏡分明甚，野干無繇匿本形。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Master Baiyu (百愚禪師語錄), spoken by Baiyu Jingsi: his verse asks why, then says that the Mirror of Qin is exceedingly clear before the hall and that the jackal cannot hide its original form. Baiyu Jingsi is not yet represented in the local roster.

Occurrences.Kwic: 進云：「當軒黯黯無秦鏡，正恁麼時如何辨的？」師云：「夜深方見把鍼人。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Master Hansong (寒松操禪師語錄), public exchange answered by Hansong Zhicao: after the interlocutor asks how to distinguish the matter without the Mirror of Qin, Hansong answers that deep at night one sees the person holding the needle. Hansong Zhicao is not yet represented in the local roster.

Occurrences.Kwic: 拄杖頭邊懸秦鏡，微塵剎土盡通靈。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Konggu Daocheng (空谷道澄禪師語錄), spoken by Konggu Daocheng: his verse hangs the Mirror of Qin at the staff head and says that all lands as numerous as dust motes become responsive. Konggu Daocheng is not yet represented in the local roster.

Occurrences.Kwic: 斯謂：「面臨秦鏡，目鑒親躬。無猜非己之疑，復何言而屬矣。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Zutang Collection (祖堂集), compiler-narrators Jing and Yun in the section on Xuefeng Yicun: Jing and Yun say to face the Mirror of Qin and inspect one's own person. This collective compiler credit is not represented in the master roster.

Occurrences.Kwic: 當軒秦鏡絕狐蹤，禁殿無人誰敢犯？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Master Baiyu (百愚禪師語錄), spoken by Baiyu Jingsi: his lineage verse says that the Mirror of Qin before the hall cuts off the fox's tracks and asks who would dare trespass in the empty forbidden palace. Baiyu Jingsi is not yet represented in the local roster.

Senses.Explanation: The Mirror of Qin is a named mirror repeatedly brought into Chan verse and exchange as an instrument before which a form, a speaking participant, or the person himself is exposed and distinguished. In the Recorded Sayings of Master Baiyu, Baiyu Jingsi says that before the mirror a jackal has no way to hide its original form; in the Recorded Sayings of Konggu Daocheng, Konggu Daocheng hangs the mirror at the head of a staff and says that every dust-mote land becomes responsive. In direct questioning recorded in the Recorded Sayings of Master Hansong, Hansong Zhicao answers after the absence of the mirror prompts the question how one can distinguish the matter. The compilers Jing and Yun, narrating Xuefeng Yicun's biography in the Zutang Collection, place Xuefeng face-to-face with the mirror and tell him to inspect himself. These are observable deployments of the mirror in appraisal and exposure, not a claim that every mention carries one secret fixed meaning. The headword occurs 29 times in 25 allowlist texts.
